Industry Challenges

The Operational Demands Behind Moving Freight

01

Shipment Visibility

Shipment status, pickup and delivery updates, and communication between relevant parties require timely information handling.

02

Dispatch & Exception Coordination

Schedule changes, delays, missed appointments, and other exceptions require follow-up and escalation.

03

Documentation & Billing

Load records, rate confirmations, delivery documentation, invoices, and related records must be handled accurately.

Our Approach

A Structured Approach to Freight Operations

01

Define the Scope

Establish supported shipment types, operating hours, systems, communication responsibilities, and escalation requirements.

02

Document the Process

Define workflows for dispatch, tracking, appointment updates, exception handling, and billing documentation.

03

Assign Responsibility

Clarify ownership of load updates, carrier or customer communication, approved system actions, and urgent escalations.

04

Review Execution

Review workflow completion, shipment-status records, outstanding exceptions, and documentation accuracy.

Responsible Operations

Accurate Shipment Data. Clear Operational Ownership.

Logistics workflows can involve shipment details, commercial records, customer information, carrier communications, and billing documentation.

Engagements should establish system permissions, approved communication procedures, recordkeeping requirements, escalation responsibilities, and the authority to make shipment or financial changes.

Safety-related, contractual, and regulated transportation decisions must remain with the appropriately authorized parties.

Common Questions

Frequently Asked Questions

What logistics operations can SkyLight Global support?

Potential services include dispatch coordination, load administration, shipment tracking, exception management, customer communication, and billing support.

Can support cover after-hours freight operations?

SkyFreight Squad’s intended positioning includes after-hours coverage. Available operating hours and service coverage should be confirmed for the proposed engagement.

Can outsourced teams work with our existing transportation systems?

System compatibility and authorized access can be assessed during scoping.

Can SLG support both customer communication and back-office freight tasks?

The engagement can be scoped around the combination of workflows that the relevant delivery team can support.
